szenen.vo: [shouting] You failed? Good! [intense] That means you actually tried.
[intense] Success is never a straight line. It goes up, down, and up again.
[intense] Every failure teaches you something the winners already learned.
[intense] Fear tells you to stop. But growth is waiting right behind it.
[shouting] The only real failure is quitting! So get back up!
[intense] Fall seven times. Stand up eight.
[intense] Try again. Fail better. Try again.
[shouting] Get back up, and keep going!
